scope: Static review of the identified clean F0 matched-control P1 staged-fit contract and launch manifest, reusing prior R1/R2 source, cache, recipe, and profile reviews. This is not an execution, fit, score, or scientific-result approval.

findings.recipe: PASS. The staged command retains the frozen matched control recipe: seed 3, own F0 combo initializer at ep3, GRU-256x2, B16/C2000, AdamW 1e-4 / wd .01, FP16, six-epoch OneCycle horizon, fixed checkpoint ep5, alpha .9 homogeneous clean-T3 targets, and no evaluation during fitting. Compared with the frozen R1 control P1 command, the only recipe-identity changes are the identified run name and validated R2 cache root.
findings.staged_schedule: PASS. The trainer loop condition for stop-after-epoch 1 executes epoch indices 0 and 1. With 746 batches per epoch and 10 chunks per sequence, the declared partial stage is 1,492 complete batches / 14,920 optimizer updates; the scheduler remains sized for all 44,760 optimizer updates across six epochs. There is no profile/max-batches truncation in the fit command.
findings.continuation_state: PASS. The exact command requests training-state serialization. The frozen trainer's resume contract binds the schedule, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, model/averages, loader state, fit membership, normalization and source/cache identities, while excluding only stage-local name/resume/output controls. Its state capture/restore path includes optimizer, scheduler, scaler, loader and RNG state, so this P1 artifact is suitable as a staged checkpoint subject to normal terminal receipt validation.
findings.data_and_ancestry: PASS from the already-reviewed actual R2 consumer receipt. Cache metadata identifies six-epoch fixed ep5 convention. Homogeneous teacher arrays are finite/hash-validated, source-qualified to seeds 3/4/5, shape-bound to [10535,20000,2] and [1405,20000,2], and exclude all 468 exposed F0 evaluation groups. Declared P1 fitting membership is 10,535 train plus 1,405 fit-valid groups with zero overlap against the 468 evaluation groups. Initializer is the own F0 combo s3 ep3 checkpoint with bound provenance.
findings.profile_and_limits: PASS for this bounded stage only. The actual R2 resource profile completed 4 batches / 40 optimizer updates with 0 AMP skips; peak worker RAM was 4,330,741,760 B and VRAM 2,178,940,928 B, with zero OOM/max/kill event deltas. Fit contract retains one CPU, 5.5 GB worker RAM, 4.3 GB allocator cap, 5 GB observed VRAM ceiling, zero loader workers, no swap, 3,600 s worker timeout and shared-GPU-lock/fresh-aggregate admission. This measurement is a short profile, not a completed two-epoch fit guarantee.
findings.launch_gates: PASS as a prepared packet. The manifest and contract leave fit authorization false and require a fresh resource observation, idle GPU/shared-lock admission, output-absence recheck, independent review and explicit root fit release. This review supplies only the independent-review condition; it does not authorize or launch the fit.

unresolved_gates: Root must issue explicit fit release and confirm fresh aggregate CPU/RAM/VRAM/GPU-lock/output-collision conditions immediately before launch.
P1 has not run. Validate its terminal checkpoint, training-state, provenance, actual membership, epoch/update counters and resource receipts before treating it as complete or resuming later stages.
F0 is repeatedly exposed local development data, not a pristine holdout; resulting scores must retain that exposure qualification.
